title: Add deadline to catalog requests
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic PR for independent hold-out evaluation.

bugs.anchor: const response = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
bugs.title: Clear the deadline on rejected fetches
bugs.rationale: Network failure or an aborted fetch rejects before clearTimeout, so each failed request retains its timer until the deadline, keeping the process active and accumulating timers under load. Use finally.
